To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the body, face, or touch are most effective channels to convey embarrassment, guilt, love, and sympathy; anger, disgust, happiness, and fear; and pride, shame, and sadness, respectively.
the body, face, or touch is most effective for communicating different emotions, and that this channel-emotion correspondence is predicted by the social function of the emotion.
different emotions are communicated through different nonverhal channels, and this channel-emotion correspondence is related to the social function of the emotion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of nonverbal communication in the expression and recognition of emotion.
the question of how people convey emotion in nonverbal communication, and how the answer may vary depending on what emotion is being communicated.
the nonverbal communication of emotions and how this may be influenced by the function of the emotion being expressed.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the social function and the channel of communication of emotion are closely related.
the nonverbal channel used in communicating emotion depends on both the emotion and why the emotion is being communicated.
different channels are used to communicate different types of emotions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
emotions are communicated through specific channels of communication.
emotions are not just communicated, but are also communicated differently depending on the social function of each emotion.
emotions are communicated most effectively through the channel most relevant for their social function.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nonverbal communication of emotions is not a unitary process.
emotions are communicated through specific channels, and that the channel used to convey an emotion is related to the social function of that emotion.
the nonverbal channel through which emotions are conveyed is important and should be considered in research on emotion.
